第69章 还书-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

又到了星期天。

王建新早上起来，先给大家开好了出门条。今天请假的人不多，他批了三个，都是想出去逛商场的。剩下的几个不打算出去，有的说要洗衣服，有的说要在宿舍睡觉。刘卫东趴在床上不起来，说这周累坏了，哪也不去。

处理完了，王建新想了想，准备跟教导员请个假，先去把罗大夫的医书送回去。

他已经全部抄完了。不光抄完了，所有的东西都深刻地印在脑子里，已经融会贯通了。罗氏正骨的手法、心法、口诀，五代人的经验积累，现在都装在他脑子里了。跟他脑海里的宗师医术一对照，有些地方是相通的，有些地方是互补的，他吸收了不少有用的东西。

他来到教导员办公室，门开着，教导员正坐在办公桌后面看文件，看见是王建新，对他笑了笑，说：“看你这样子，是准备请假吗？”

王建新笑了笑，对教导员说：“我想回家一趟。”

教导员从抽屉里拿出一张纸，刷刷刷写好，盖了章，递给他：“去吧，记得到点归队就行。”

王建新敬了个礼，接过请假条，出了学校，坐上公交车，去往双桥公社。

一路颠簸，公交车晃晃悠悠的，车厢里挤满了人，有挑着担子的，有抱着孩子的，王建新站在过道里，一只手抓着扶手，一只手护着挎包。窗外的风景从楼房变成平房，从平房变成庄稼地，越走越偏。

下了车，他找个无人处，从空间取出一网兜苹果和梨。苹果是红的，梨是黄的，个顶个的大，水灵灵的，看着就喜人。热带水果他没拿——北京基本上没有卖的，不方便往出拿。但他的苹果和梨可是好东西，空间里种的，带着灵气，比外面卖的好吃多了。

想了想，又拿出两罐麦乳精和一包茶叶。麦乳精是铁罐装的，上海产的，市面上不好买。茶叶是龙井，也是好东西。

拎着东西，他直接来到卫生院罗大夫的门诊室。

罗大夫正在给一个病人接骨。病人是个四十来岁的庄稼汉，胳膊摔断了，肿得老高。罗大夫的手在他胳膊上摸来摸去，摸准了位置，一拉一推，“咔嗒”一声，骨头复位了。病人“啊”了一声，然后长长地出了口气，说“不疼了”。

罗大夫看见王建新进来，只是点了点头，没说话，继续用夹板把病人的胳膊固定好，缠上绷带，打了个活结。嘱咐了几句“别干重活，过半个月来换药”，病人千恩万谢地走了。

前后不到十分钟。

罗大夫洗了洗手，坐到了诊桌后面。她七十多岁的人了，动作还是那么利索，腰板挺得直直的，一点不显老。

王建新赶忙上前，把手上的水果和麦乳精放在桌子上，然后从挎包里拿出罗大夫的医书，恭恭敬敬地放在罗大夫面前。

“谢谢您，罗大夫。”王建新说，“这本书我已经全部抄录下来了，后期我一定会努力认真地学习。”

罗大夫看着桌子上的医书，双手拿起来，轻轻地抚摸着。封面的皮子磨得发亮，边角都卷了，但她摸得很轻，像是在摸一个孩子的脸。她翻开看了看，纸张泛黄，红笔批注还在，跟她交出去的时候一模一样。

她点了点头，把书放在桌上，看着王建新，说：“你是个优秀的大夫。我也听说了你的事迹，好样的。”

她拿起网兜里的一个苹果，在手里转了转，看了看，苹果又大又红，在阳光下闪着光。“这水果可是长得真不赖，用心啦，小子。”

然后她擦了擦苹果，便慢慢咬了一口。别看七十岁的人了，牙口还不错，一口咬下去，咔嚓脆响。她一边嚼着苹果一边点头，含混不清地说：“这个苹果好。”

王建新笑了笑，说：“罗大夫，我还要回家去看看父母，便先告辞了。”

罗大夫摆摆手，嘴里还嚼着苹果，没说话。

王建新出了罗大夫的诊室，又和赵医生、王大夫等相熟的人打了招呼。赵医生正在看病，抬头朝他点了点头。王医生在药房里抓药，隔着窗户喊了一声“王队长有空常来”。最后他来到赵院长办公室，赵院长正在看文件，看见他来了，赶紧从抽屉里拿出一盒烟，抽出一根递给他。

两人抽着烟，聊了几句。赵院长说卫生院最近病人多了不少，多亏医疗队打下的底子。王建新说赵院长客气了，主要是你们工作做得好。抽完了烟，王建新便告辞离开。

It's Sunday again.

When Wang Jianxin got up in the morning, he first issued exit tickets for everyone.Not many people asked for leave today. He approved three, all of whom wanted to go shopping in the mall.The remaining few didn't plan to go out, some said they wanted to wash clothes, and some said they wanted to sleep in the dormitory.Liu Weidong lay on the bed and refused to get up, saying that he was exhausted this week and would not go anywhere.

After finishing the processing, Wang Jianxin thought for a while and prepared to ask for leave from the instructor to send back Dr. Luo's medical books first.

He has copied them all.Not only did I finish copying, but everything was deeply imprinted in my mind and I had already understood it.Luo's bone-setting techniques, mental methods, formulas, and the accumulated experience of five generations are now stored in his mind.Comparing it with the master's medical skills in his mind, some parts were similar and some were complementary. He absorbed a lot of useful things.

He came to the instructor's office. The door was open. The instructor was sitting behind the desk reading documents. When he saw it was Wang Jianxin, he smiled at him and said, "Looking at you, are you planning to take leave?"

Wang Jianxin smiled and said to the instructor: "I want to go home."

The instructor took out a piece of paper from the drawer, wrote it down, stamped it, and handed it to him: "Go ahead, just remember to return to the team on time."

Wang Jianxin saluted, took the leave request, left the school, got on the bus, and went to Shuangqiao Commune.

The bus was bumpy along the way, the bus was swaying, and the carriage was crowded with people, some carrying burdens and some holding children. Wang Jianxin stood in the aisle, holding the armrest with one hand and protecting his satchel with the other.The scenery outside the window changed from buildings to bungalows, and from bungalows to crop fields, becoming more and more deviated as we walked.

After getting out of the car, he found a deserted place and took out a bag of apples and pears from the space.The apples are red, the pears are yellow, they are big and juicy, and they are pleasing to look at.He didn't take any tropical fruits - basically none of them are sold in Beijing, so it's not convenient to take them out.But his apples and pears are good things. The ones grown in the space are full of spiritual energy and are much more delicious than those sold outside.

After thinking for a while, he took out two cans of malted milk and a bag of tea.Malted milk powder comes in iron cans and is produced in Shanghai. It is not easily available on the market.The tea is Longjing, which is also a good thing.

Carrying his things, he went directly to Dr. Luo's clinic in the health center.

Doctor Luo is setting the bones of a patient.The patient was a farmer in his forties. His arm was broken and swollen.Dr. Luo's hand felt around on his arm, and he found the right position. He pulled and pushed, and with a "click", the bone reset.The patient said "ah", then took a long breath and said "it doesn't hurt anymore".

When Dr. Luo saw Wang Jianxin coming in, he just nodded without saying anything and continued to fix the patient's arm with a splint, wrap it with a bandage, and tie a slip knot.After a few instructions, "Don't do heavy work and change the dressing in half a month," the patient left with great gratitude.

Less than ten minutes before and after.

Doctor Luo washed his hands and sat behind the consultation table.She is over seventy years old, but her movements are still as nimble and her back is straight, and she does not look old at all.

Wang Jianxin hurried forward, put the fruits and malted milk on the table, then took out Dr. Luo's medical book from his bag and placed it respectfully in front of Dr. Luo.

"Thank you, Doctor Luo." Wang Jianxin said, "I have copied all of this book. I will definitely study hard and seriously in the future."

Doctor Luo looked at the medical book on the table, picked it up with both hands, and stroked it gently.The leather of the cover was worn shiny and the corners were curled, but she touched it very lightly, as if touching a child's face.She opened it and looked at it. The paper was yellowed and the red pen annotations were still there, exactly as when she handed it over.

She nodded, put the book on the table, looked at Wang Jianxin, and said, "You are an excellent doctor. I have also heard about your deeds, well done."

She picked up an apple in her net bag, turned it around in her hand, and looked at it. The apple was big and red, shining in the sun."This fruit looks really good, so be careful, boy."

Then she wiped the apple and slowly took a bite.Despite being a seventy-year-old man, his teeth are pretty good, and when he bites into them, there is a crunching sound.She nodded while chewing the apple and said vaguely: "This apple is good."

Wang Jianxin smiled and said, "Doctor Luo, I want to go home to see my parents, so I'll take my leave first."

Dr. Luo waved his hand, still chewing the apple in his mouth and said nothing.

Wang Jianxin left Dr. Luo's clinic and greeted Dr. Zhao, Dr. Wang and other familiar people.Dr. Zhao, who was treating a patient, raised his head and nodded towards him.Doctor Wang was taking medicine in the pharmacy and shouted through the window, "Captain Wang, come here often when he is free."Finally, he came to Dean Zhao's office. Dean Zhao was reading documents. When he saw him coming, he quickly took out a box of cigarettes from the drawer, pulled out one and handed it to him.

The two smoked cigarettes and chatted for a while.Director Zhao said that the health center has seen a lot more patients recently, thanks to the foundation laid by the medical team.Wang Jianxin said that Dean Zhao was too polite, mainly because you have done a good job.After finishing his cigarette, Wang Jianxin said goodbye and left.
